blocks.title: Strix's pentest toolkit, driven by your own agent
blocks.description: A ready-made security sandbox and Strix's 78-skill library, wired into the conversation you already have. Your model does the thinking; Strix supplies the environment and the tradecraft.

showcase.assistant_reply: Started the sandbox; one critical IDOR filed.

items.title: The real toolchain
items.description: nmap, nuclei, ffuf, sqlmap, subfinder, Caido, agent-browser, trivy, gitleaks and trufflehog, inside one container.

items.title: Strix's own skills
items.description: 78 knowledge packs on vulnerabilities, technologies and tooling - loaded by the agent before it starts testing.

items.title: Your model, your key
items.description: No second credential: inference runs in Astravia on the model you already picked.

items.title: Evidence-backed findings
items.description: Every finding carries the request, payload or code path that proved it, with CVSS, CWE and remediation.

items.title: Open the console once
items.description: Strix scans sits in the tab menu; the plugin adds nothing under the conversation until you open it.

items.title: Point it at a target
items.description: Type a host, URL or local repo and press Enter. The request goes to your agent with Strix's method attached.

items.title: Watch and read
items.description: Commands run inside Strix's sandbox and appear in the trace; each confirmed issue lands in Findings with proof and fix.

blocks.content: Only scan systems you are authorised to test. Strix sends real attack traffic to the targets you give it.
